# org: define milestones

Split the roadmap into understandable user-facing directions, so that tasks are tied to the outcome expected from a release.

The historical plan:

| Series | User-facing outcome |
| --- | --- |
| v0.1.x | Viewing and analysing the GitHub Contributions Calendar |
| v0.2.x | Managing GitHub labels |

The contribution issues are attached to the v0.1.x milestone. The organizational criterion is that tasks have an agreed target release and that the milestone description explains what the user gets.

Related: [[issue-80]], [[issue-30]], [[issue-16]].
